summary.text: Rob Nosse is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 42 who has served since July 7, 2014, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rob Nosse attended Miami University and has worked as a labor representative for the Oregon Nurses Association since 2004.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Behavioral Health Committee and a member of the Business and Labor and House Rules committees.
